title: Why Do Rainbows Appear After Rain? The Sun's Magic Mirror!

lines.text: The dark rainstorm stops, the golden sun peeks out, and look high up in the blue sky!
lines.caps: The storm stops, the *SUN peeks out, | and look high up in the *BLUE | *SKY!

lines.text: A glowing ribbon of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet!
lines.caps: A glowing ribbon of *RED, | orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and *VIOLET!

lines.text: Where did those brilliant colors come from? Sunlight looks completely white!
lines.caps: Where did those *COLORS come from? | Sunlight looks completely *WHITE!

lines.text: White light is actually a team of all seven colors traveling together!
lines.caps: White light is a *TEAM | of all seven colors traveling *TOGETHER!

lines.text: Millions of floating raindrops act like tiny glass prism mirrors!
lines.caps: Millions of floating *RAINDROPS | act like tiny glass prism *MIRRORS!

lines.text: When sunlight enters a raindrop, it slows down and bends—a trick called refraction!
lines.caps: When sunlight enters a raindrop, | it slows down and *BENDS!

lines.text: Red light bends the least, while violet light bends the most!
lines.caps: Red light bends the *LEAST, | while violet bends the *MOST!

lines.text: The colors separate and bounce back into your eyes as a majestic circular arch!
lines.caps: The colors separate and bounce | into your eyes as a majestic *ARCH!
